strict.measure: Gross Regional Product (NIEIR via economy.id); FY2023-24 value in 2023/24 base-year dollars = current prices for that year
strict.area: City of Melbourne local government area
strict.source: National Institute of Economic and Industry Research (NIEIR) ©2026, compiled by .id in the council's economy.id economic profile (Gross product page)
strict.notes: economy.id expresses all years in 2023/24 base-year dollars, so only the FY2023-24 value equals nominal/current prices. The page's headline FY2024-25 figure ($138,478m) is in 2023/24 dollars (i.e. real) and was not used; the nominal FY2024-25 value is not published. Cross-check: NIEIR's FY2023-24 state totals in the same table match ABS current-price GSP 2023-24 within ~0.3%. The council itself quotes this series as 'Gross Local Product' (e.g. $126.8bn for 2023-24 in 2025 strategy coverage, from the previous NIEIR release in 2022/23 dollars). Very high per-resident value (~$727k on 187,565 residents, June 2024) reflects the CBD job base.
